title: Cloud Project Coordinator
description:
**Role Summary**

The Project Coordinator / Associate Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of Scaleios customer projects across Azure, Microsoft 365 and AWS. This is a dedicated project management role focused on driving projects to on-time completion - owning project onboarding and plans, managing timelines and stakeholders, flagging timeline lapses and escalations, calling out scope deviations, and ensuring smooth transitions from the Sales/PreSales phase through delivery and into Support. The role does not carry account management, upselling or marketing responsibilities. It is ideal for a structured, proactive individual who thrives on ownership, follow-through and cross-functional coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

Project Planning & Timeline Management

* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for assigned projects throughout the lifecycle, from kick-off call to handover.
* Prepare and proactively maintain Project Plans in the project management tool (e.g., MS Planner) in coordination with the Technical Project Team and customer, capturing tasks, owners, effort and timelines.
* Drive projects to stay within the agreed delivery timeline, tracking milestones, dependencies and completion status with trackers kept updated in real time.

Stakeholder Management & Status Reporting

* Share regular project status reports with the respective stakeholders, including after every key meeting or decision point.
* Circulate Minutes of Meeting capturing decisions, action items and owners, and follow up to closure.
* Maintain proactive, clear communication with customers and internal teams (Technical, Sales, PreSales, Operations, Support) to keep everyone aligned.

Scope, Risk & Escalation Management

* Proactively identify and flag timeline lapses, risks and blockers to the Project Lead before they become escalations.
* Call out and formally report any scope creep or deviation in the proposed solution, in coordination with the Customer, Technical and Sales teams.
* Own and track project-level escalations to resolution, following the correct escalation matrix and communication path.

Project Onboarding, Handover & Transition

* Own the project onboarding process end to end - collect all required onboarding data from the Sales/Account Management team and follow the standard onboarding process for every assigned project.
* Conduct the project kick-off call, with onboarding and subsequent project activities commencing immediately thereafter.
* Conduct formal handover sessions for large projects and prepare handover documentation (solution overview, resource details, support scope, contacts and escalation matrix).
* Ensure a smooth transition into the Support team immediately after handover for customers who have opted for support, with all relevant details formally handed over.

Process Adherence & Documentation

* Ensure consistent use of the proper project management tools and processes across all assigned projects.
* Maintain complete, up-to-date internal project documentation, and help standardize and communicate the onboarding-to-handover process to the PreSales, Sales and BizOps teams.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in IT, Engineering, Business or a related field.
* 2-4 years of experience in project coordination or project management, preferably in IT / cloud services delivery.
* Working familiarity with cloud and Microsoft technologies (Azure, Microsoft 365, AWS) is a strong advantage.
* Hands-on proficiency with project management/tracking tools (MS Planner or equivalent) and Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Excel, SharePoint).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for status reporting, MoMs and customer-facing correspondence.
* Highly organised and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple concurrent projects, deadlines, and stakeholders.
* Strong sense of ownership, proactiveness and follow-through in flagging risks and driving projects to closure.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* A recognised project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM or Agile/Scrum) or willingness to obtain one.
* Experience managing cloud infrastructure or migration projects (Azure/AWS/M365).
* Familiarity with SLAs, escalation matrices and support-transition processes.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Have you managed an Azure migration project from initial customer kick-off through final handover?
* Have you independently prepared project plans, milestones, task assignments and status reports?
* Have you used MS Planner, Microsoft Teams or another project-management tool to track project delivery?
* Have you coordinated handovers between technical delivery teams and Support teams?

title: Project Planner
description:
**Job Title**

Project Planner

**Job Description Summary**

The Project Planner will be responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules for large-scale hotel, resort, and hospitality construction projects. The role will ensure effective planning, progress tracking, resource optimization, and timely project delivery while supporting project leadership with accurate forecasting and reporting.

**Job Description**

About the Role:

* Develop, maintain, and monitor integrated project schedules for construction projects from design through handover.
* Prepare detailed project plans, work breakdown structures (WBS), resource-loaded schedules, critical path analyses, and project progress reports using Primavera P6 and/or MS Project.
* Coordinate with project managers, consultants, architects, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure alignment of project milestones and deliverables.
* Track project performance against baseline schedules, identify delays and risks, and recommend recovery plans and mitigation strategies.
* Generate periodic progress reports, dashboards, earned value analysis, and executive presentations to support project decision-making.
* Review contractor schedules, evaluate extension of time (EOT) claims, and monitor compliance with contractual project timelines.
* Support cost and project controls teams through schedule integration, forecasting, and planning-related analyses.

About You:

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling for commercial construction projects.
* Strong expertise in MS Project, project controls, critical path methodology (CPM), and project scheduling techniques.
* Proven experience in managing complex hospitality development projects from concept/design stage through construction and commissioning.
* Excellent analytical, reporting, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of construction contracts, claims management, risk assessment, and project control best practices.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders and project teams.

Why Join Us?

* Opportunity to work on prestigious hotel, resort, and hospitality developments across diverse locations.
* Exposure to large-scale projects with international standards and best-in-class project management practices.
* Strong focus on professional development, technical training, and career growth opportunities.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment that values innovation, excellence, and continuous improvement.

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Statement**

**We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.**

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every individual is respected and valued. We celebrate diversity across all backgrounds and experiences and believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities for everyone.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager

About the Role

Elkanio is looking for an experienced **Project Manager** to take ownership of planning, coordinating, and delivering technology projects from initiation through successful completion.

You will work closely with **clients, product teams, developers, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, and leadership** to ensure projects are delivered within agreed scope, timelines, quality expectations, and business objectives.

The ideal candidate has **3–5 years of experience in software project management or delivery management**, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to understand technical discussions and translate business requirements into actionable delivery plans.

This is a hands\-on role requiring strong ownership, proactive communication, structured planning, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced technology environment.

What You'll DoProject Ownership \& Planning

* Own assigned projects and initiatives from **requirement gathering through delivery and production rollout**.
* Understand project objectives, scope, requirements, timelines, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, schedules, and delivery trackers.
* Break down requirements into actionable workstreams and coordinate execution across teams.
* Track progress against milestones and proactively address deviations.
* Coordinate releases, UAT, deployments, and post\-release activities.
* Ensure deliverables are completed within agreed scope, timelines, and quality expectations.

Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as a key point of contact for assigned clients and projects.
* Establish regular communication and reporting cadence with stakeholders.
* Lead client meetings, requirement discussions, sprint reviews, demos, and status calls.
* Clearly communicate project progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and upcoming milestones.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and proactively communicate changes or potential delays.
* Ensure client decisions and requirements are clearly understood and communicated internally.
* Build strong working relationships with technical and business stakeholders.

Requirement \& Scope Management

* Work with clients and product stakeholders to understand and clarify business requirements.
* Coordinate with technical teams to translate requirements into actionable development tasks.
* Support backlog prioritization and release planning.
* Identify dependencies and gaps in requirements before development begins.
* Manage changes to scope and communicate their impact on timelines, resources, and delivery.
* Maintain clear visibility of agreed scope and approved changes.
* Work with Product Owners and technical teams to ensure requirements are ready for development.

Team \& Delivery Management

* Coordinate development, QA, UI/UX, DevOps, product, and other teams involved in delivery.
* Ensure teams have the required information and dependencies to execute their work.
* Track resource availability and highlight capacity or allocation constraints.
* Identify blockers and drive them toward resolution.
* Coordinate cross\-team dependencies and ensure timely handoffs.
* Support teams in maintaining focus on sprint and release objectives.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately when leadership intervention is required.

Risk, Issue \& Dependency Management

* Proactively identify and maintain visibility of **project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies**.
* Define mitigation actions with relevant stakeholders.
* Track issues through to closure and ensure clear ownership.
* Identify potential schedule, resource, technical, or scope risks early.
* Escalate critical risks and delivery concerns in a timely manner.
* Facilitate root\-cause discussions for significant or recurring delivery issues.
* Maintain appropriate risk and issue registers.

Agile \& Delivery Practices

* Work effectively with teams following **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives where required.
* Track sprint commitments, velocity, blockers, and delivery outcomes.
* Work with Product Owners and engineering teams to maintain a prioritized backlog.
* Coordinate release planning and track release readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve team processes, delivery predictability, and collaboration.

Reporting \& Governance

* Prepare regular **project status reports and management updates**.
* Provide visibility into project health, milestones, progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and resource requirements.
* Track planned versus actual delivery timelines.
* Maintain project dashboards, trackers, action logs, and decision records.
* Provide concise and accurate updates to leadership and clients.
* Establish and maintain appropriate project governance and reporting practices.

What We're Looking For

* **3–5 years of experience** in software project management, delivery management, or a similar technology role.
* Proven experience managing software projects through the **SDLC**, from requirements through production.
* Strong understanding of **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Strong stakeholder and client management skills.
* Experience managing cross\-functional technology teams.
* Strong planning, organization, prioritization, and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, workstreams, and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong risk, issue, dependency, and scope management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
